an4.101:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an4.101:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an4.101:2.8: Evam eva kho bhikkhave cattāro 'me valāhakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmiṃ.
an4.101:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo gajjitā hoti no vassitā?
an4.101:3.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo bhāsitā hoti no kattā.
an4.101:3.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo gajjitā hoti no vassitā,
an4.101:3.4: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave valāhako gajjitā no vassitā,
an4.101:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo vassitā hoti no gajjitā?
an4.101:4.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo kattā hoti no bhāsitā.
an4.101:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo vassitā hoti no gajjitā,
an4.101:4.4: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave valāhako vassitā no gajjitā,
an4.101:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo n' eva gajjitā no vassitā?
an4.101:5.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo n' eva bhāsitā hoti no kattā.
an4.101:5.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo n' eva gajjitā hoti no vassitā,
an4.101:5.4: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave valāhako n' eva gajjitā no vassitā,
an4.101:6.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca?
an4.101:6.2: Idha bhikkhave ekacco puggalo bhāsitā ca hoti kattā ca.
an4.101:6.3: Evam kho bhikkhave puggalo gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca,
an4.101:6.4: seyyathāpi so bhikkhave valāhako gajjitā ca hoti vassitā ca,
an4.101:6.6: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro valāhakūpamā puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 102. 1.
